item.title: The Latest: Minnesota prosecutor asks public to share Renee Good shooting evidence with her office
item.description: Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty on Friday called on members of the public to send any video or other evidence in the fatal shooting of Renee Good in Minneapolis directly to her office.

item.title: Bus delays leave Brunswick County Middle School students waiting for hours
item.description: Some Brunswick County middle schoolers were left waiting for hours this morning when the bus that was supposed to pick them up never showed.

item.title: Warm January weather draws many to Wrightsville Beach
item.description: It was a warm, January day in the Cape Fear Region on Friday and many flocked to the beach.

item.title: Wilmington eyes first no-barrier, city-operated homeless shelter
item.description: A priority for the Wilmington city council in 2026 is to establish a city-operated homeless shelter. The proposal would establish the first shelter with a “no to low barrier of entry.”

item.title: Bobby Petrino joins North Carolina as offensive coordinator for Bill Belichick
item.description: Bobby Petrino was named North Carolina's new offensive coordinator for coach Bill Belichick on Friday.

item.title: Beach renourishment projects delayed due to surge in demand for dredges
item.description: The project at Carolina Beach is paused because the dredge used to collect and bring sand from offshore is being moved to another project up near Philadelphia.

item.title: Trump promises oil executives ‘total safety’ if they invest in Venezuela after Maduro ouster
item.description: President Donald Trump on Friday called on oil executives to rush back into Venezuela as the White House tries to quickly secure $100 billion in investments to fix the country's neglected infrastructure and fully tap into its expansive reserves of petroleum.

item.title: Full Court Press January 9, 2026
item.description: Now that the holidays are over, conference games make up the majority of what remains of high school basketball season in the Cape Fear.

item.title: Parks Foundation to host 2nd Annual Mayor’s Gala in Burgaw
item.description: The Parks Foundation of Burgaw announces the 2nd Annual Mayor’s Gala, scheduled for March 14, 2026, from 7 p.m. to 10 p.m. at the Historic Burgaw Train Depot.

item.title: Polar Plunge returns to Kure Beach to benefit Special Olympics New Hanover County
item.description: The 22nd annual Polar Plunge is scheduled starting at 11 a.m. on Saturday February 21, 2026, at the Kure Beach Pavilion.
